sections.text:
Type MFAC relays provide high 
 speed differential protection for various items of power system plant 
 including generators, reactors, busbars, motors and the individual windings of 
 power transformers the single element version type MFAC14 is applied when 
 protection is required for earth faults only. The relay measuring element is 
 basically an attracted armature unit of simple and robust construction, 
 supplied from a bridge rectifier. setting are determined by a series of 
 resistors, selected on a seven way plug bridge. type MFAC relays are suitable 
 for use with 0.5A,1A and 5A current transformers at 50Hz or 60Hz .

This procedure details the 
 steps required to completely check the proper operation and calibration of the 
 MFAC14 relay. It is recommended this procedure be carried out on a yearly 
 bases.

The document is formatted the 
 way to minimize the possibility of error causing personal injury or damage to 
 equipment.

sections.text: Voltage PICK-UP and DROUP OUT CHECK Test

items:
Connect the external power supply (220 V, 50 HZ) to the voltage injection 
 tester at terminals # 1,3 or 1,4 and the tester output terminals #1,2 will be 
 connected to the relay.

Slowly increase the voltage until the internal contacts of the relay are 
 closed. The relay must operate with a voltage between +/- 10% of the setting 
 value.
Record this value on the test sheet.

Slowly decrease the voltage until the internal contacts of the relay are 
 opened
Record this value on the test sheet.

Request the operator to switch 
 on the main circuit breaker.

Operate the output auxiliary 
 contact by injection to trip the circuit breaker.

Check that the circuit breaker

Introduction

 basically an attracted armature unit of simple and robust construction, 
 supplied from a bridge rectifier. setting are determined by a series of 
 resistors, selected on a seven way plug bridge. type MFAC relays are suitable 
 for use with 0.5A,1A and 5A current transformers at 50Hz or 60Hz .

Procedure (s)
Voltage PICK-UP and DROUP OUT CHECK Test
Connect the external power supply (220 V, 50 HZ) to the voltage injection 
 tester at terminals # 1,3 or 1,4 and the tester output terminals #1,2 will be 
 connected to the relay.
Slowly increase the voltage until the internal contacts of the relay are 
 closed. The relay must operate with a voltage between +/- 10% of the setting 
 value.
Record this value on the test sheet.
Slowly decrease the voltage until the internal contacts of the relay are 
 opened
Record this value on the test sheet.

 on the main circuit breaker.
Operate the output auxiliary 
 contact by injection to trip the circuit breaker.
Check that the circuit breaker
